# finla

> Turkey's first chat-native e-invoice assistant.

This file mirrors the product facts on https://www.heyfinla.com (Turkish landing page). It is the single-source brief for AI agents.

## Glossary

- **GİB** — Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı (Turkish Revenue Administration)
- **e-Fatura** — Turkey's official B2B electronic invoice standard
- **e-Arşiv** — Turkey's electronic archive invoice standard (typically B2C / non–e-Fatura recipients)
- **KDV** — Turkish VAT
- **tevkifat** — VAT withholding
- **istisna** — VAT exemption codes
- **KOBİ** — SME (small and medium-sized enterprise)
- **KVKK** — Turkey's personal data protection law (GDPR-analogue)

## Summary

finla is an AI-powered e-invoice assistant for freelancers and SMEs (KOBİs) in Turkey. No forms, no menus, no accounting-software screens. To issue, query, or share an invoice, you message finla—AI handles the rest.

Trust signals: GİB-compliant e-Fatura & e-Arşiv · GİB-approved integrator infrastructure · KVKK-compliant.

Tagline: No menus—just chat. (Turkish: “Menü yok, yazışalım.”)

## How it works

Three steps. finla does two of them.

1. Describe what you need — e.g. “Issue a 10,000 TL + KDV invoice to Yılmaz İnşaat” — everyday Turkish, one sentence.
2. finla understands and prepares — AI extracts recipient, amount, and taxes; applies KDV, tevkifat, and istisna codes automatically; asks for your approval.
3. Submitted to GİB — Once approved, the invoice is finalized in seconds via a GİB-approved integrator. You track status in chat.

Typical time: ~30 seconds from one sentence to an official invoice.

## Features

Not an accounting program. An accounting assistant.

- Issue e-Fatura & e-Arşiv via chat: Extracts recipient, amount, and tax from one sentence and submits to GİB after your approval. Chooses document type (e-Fatura / e-Arşiv) from the recipient's tax status.
- Incoming invoices in one list: Every invoice from the integrator appears instantly; accept or reject from chat or the list in one tap.
- Tax logic built in: KDV rates, tevkifat, and istisna codes match GİB code lists—even if you don't know the rate.
- Foreign-currency invoices at live FX: Say “issue a $500 invoice”; finla fetches the day's rate, converts to TRY, and puts it on the invoice.
- Ask for a report, get Excel: “Export last month to Excel”—an .xlsx ready to share with your accountant, in seconds.
- Replies stream live: Answers arrive word by word in real time. No spinner; you see what finla is doing as it thinks.

## Technology

Not a chat bubble. An end-to-end invoice agent.

Every message goes to a tool-using AI agent: it resolves intent, picks the right tool, calculates taxes, and finalizes the document through a GİB-approved integrator.

Pipeline: You (one sentence of Turkish) → finla agent (Claude · 13 specialist tools) → Integrator (GİB-approved e-document infrastructure) → GİB (official e-Fatura / e-Arşiv).

- 13 specialist tools — issue, query, inbox, Excel, FX rates…
- 100% GİB data contract — documents travel end-to-end on the GİB schema
- <1s first token — replies stream in real time
- 24/7 — invoicing is not limited to business hours

Infrastructure: real-time streaming architecture, serverless functions, and an end-to-end protected GİB data schema.

## Security

Built with fintech discipline. Invoices are commercial secrets. finla was written that way from the first line.

- Encrypted credential vault: Integrator credentials live in a server-side encrypted vault only the server can decrypt. They never land on the app.
- Face ID app lock: The app locks when backgrounded; return requires Face ID or biometric auth.
- Phone, SMS code, PIN: No password to memorize. On signup you get an SMS code; after verify you set a PIN. Later logins need your phone and PIN.
- Session on-device only: Session keys stay in the device secure store; each request uses short-lived signed keys.
- Automatic log redaction: PIN, codes, and identity fields are masked before they can hit system logs.
- KVKK-compliant: Data is processed only to provide the service; not shared with third parties.

## Who it's for

Not a replacement for your accountant. A layer that reduces the work that reaches them.

- Freelancers: Don't want to open accounting software for a single line-item invoice at month-end. Write, issue, get back to work.
- SME (KOBİ) owners: Want a fast self-serve layer between them and their accountant. Get the report from finla, send the Excel to the accountant.
- E-commerce sellers: High-volume, repetitive invoicing during the day. Paste order details; the rest is automatic.

## FAQ

### Are invoices I issue with finla official?
Yes. Invoices are issued through a GİB-approved e-document integrator, fully aligned with GİB e-Fatura and e-Arşiv standards. They have the same legal validity as invoices from any accounting program.

### Do I need to know whether to issue e-Fatura or e-Arşiv?
No. finla checks whether the recipient is an e-Fatura taxpayer and chooses the correct document type. You only say who and how much.

### Do I need to know KDV, tevkifat, istisna, etc.?
No. finla applies KDV rates, tevkifat, and istisna codes from GİB code lists automatically. It still shows every line for your approval before sending.

### Can I issue foreign-currency invoices?
Yes. When you say “issue a $500 invoice,” finla fetches the day's rate, converts to TRY, and writes it on the invoice.

### Are my data and GİB credentials safe?
Integrator credentials are stored in a server-side encrypted vault and never download to the app. Your session stays in the device secure store; the app locks with Face ID. Sensitive fields are not written to system logs.

### Do I have to give up my accountant?
No—the opposite. finla takes daily work off your plate (issuing, tracking, exporting lists); at period end you share an Excel export with your accountant in one command.

### How do I get started?
finla is currently in early access. Fill in the early-access form—invites are sent in signup order. When your invite arrives, download the app, verify your phone number via SMS, and set a PIN. Connect your existing e-invoice account and issue your first invoice from chat—usually a few minutes.

## Early access
